title.zh: 认知、学习与演化心理的相连解释
title.en: Connected explanation of cognition, learning and evolutionary psychology

scope.zh: 本会话独立授权的完整认知目标；当前从学习和跨层次选择的连接推进。
scope.en: This session's independently authorized full cognitive objective; the current continuation connects learning to selection across scales.

objective.zh: 完成认知、学习与演化心理的相连解释，说明形成、保持和使用怎样经实际后果改变组织及其学习、评价和接续方式。
objective.en: Complete the connected explanation of cognition, learning and evolutionary psychology, including how formation, retention and use change organization and its learning, evaluation and continuation through actual consequences.

premises.zh: 同一关系展开；公开实际作用、更新、传递、支持和对应条件。多层次选择不默认单一报酬、固定层级或必然有利方向。保留G0/J的独立规范范围。
premises.en: Begin with one relational unfolding; disclose operation, updating, transmission, support and correspondence conditions. Multilevel selection presupposes neither one reward, a fixed hierarchy nor inevitable favorable direction. Preserve the separate normative scope of G0/J.

completion.zh: 遵从现有认知章节十项完整解释职责。完成一个条件连接或否定不成立的普遍推论不完成全部目标；不得重开已完成机制。当前连接须综合正面机制、实际形式检查、原典对应与实质反审。
completion.en: Retain the ten full-explanation obligations in the existing cognition chapter. Completing a conditional connection or rejecting an unsupported universal inference does not complete the whole objective; completed mechanisms are not reopened. The current connection requires affirmative mechanism, actual formal checks, primary-source correspondence and substantive counterreview.
